_comment: The frozen case set for `python -m cv.run_eval`. A FILE and not a glob over applications/, because
a glob would silently change the case set every time a résumé is written — two runs would look
Two cases, chosen to sit at opposite ends rather than to be a sample. Apex is a current tailored
output that went through the review loop; College Board is a real résumé really sent, written
before the current rules and still carrying two retracted claims. A test set of two good documents
would tell us almost nothing — the weak anchor is what makes a score movement legible.
Adding a case is one line. Prefer adding a SHAPE that is missing (an AI-heavy req, a backend req)
over adding another of something already here. Never remove a case to make a number look better.
